content: TypeScript ECS: bitECS 0.4.0 is a 2025 complete rewrite, zero dependency, ~5kb, SoA/TypedArray stores, query pipeline, serialization, multithreading/SharedArrayBuffer. miniplex 2.0.0 (2023) is DX-focused, object entities, no built-in systems - simpler but not perf-oriented. For a deterministic physics sim, bitECS or plain typed arrays is preferred.
